about: Made-up subtopics in other languages, for question-only tests of generation in a language other than English, one per script family we ship: German (Latin with its own conventions), Japanese (CJK, no spaces), Arabic (right to left), Thai (no spaces, its own script), Hindi (Devanagari) and Russian (Cyrillic, plural-heavy). `language` is the site's language code. Topics and subtopics are written in the domain's language, as the pipeline writes them. Built by hand 2026-10-20; no company's text.
